title: Compatibility
hintSame: Pick two different profiles to see how their charts meet.
hintNeedTwo: You'll need at least two profiles to compare. Add a partner, family member, or friend from the home screen.
footer: Vedic charts hint at patterns, not destinies. The way two people show up for each other day after day matters more than any score.

summary.strong: {{a}} and {{b}} share a naturally compatible chart pairing — temperament, vitality, and daily rhythm all line up well. A friendship or partnership here has good wind behind it.
summary.workable: {{a}} and {{b}} have real points of harmony, plus a few traditional friction points. Communication and patience matter more than they would in an effortless pairing — but that's true of most lasting bonds.
summary.challenging: Traditional matching marks this as a careful pairing for {{a}} and {{b}}. That doesn't mean it can't work — many real-life partnerships do — but the chart asks for awareness, not autopilot.

gana.name: Temperament (Gana)
gana.high: Your inner natures move in the same key.
gana.mid: Different temperaments, but workable with care.
gana.low: Two very different inner rhythms — you'll need to translate often.

nadi.name: Health & vitality (Nadi)
nadi.good: Your constitutions complement each other well.
nadi.same: Similar constitutions — traditionally a caution flag for shared depletion.

bhakoot.name: Lifestyle harmony (Bhakoot)
bhakoot.good: Your day-to-day rhythms can sync easily.
bhakoot.dosha: Your moon signs sit in a classically restless angle to each other.
